narr: Diurnal showers and thunderstorms yielded a briefly severe storm in Campbell County.
ev: The river gauge on Porters Creek, 3 miles south of Pittman Center in the Greenbrier area, reached minor flood stage as a result of heavy rains.

Spotter reported minor flooding near intersection of Opie Arnold Road and Jaynes Road in Limestone. Several inches of water was flowing over SR-75, which represented over a foot of rise on the adjacent stream.

Social media image showed water flowing over a driveway and through a hay field. Estimated to be at least a few inches deep, with the person saying it was the highest water they'd seen in four years living there.
lsr: Porters Creek reached minor flood stage.
